regime_context: Leadership is narrow and concentrated: Memory/HBM & Storage (SMH proxy) leads with a large margin (score 2.562 vs 1.153) and trend-health (Hurst 'trend', durability 0.49) but zero breadth, while eligible breadth is narrowing (0.47 eligible frac). The validated leg here is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so trend-state is real; but track_record dir_accuracy is 0.444 on n=108, so directional conviction must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the wide leader margin (1.409) closes via Non-AI Software (IGV) or Cybersecurity (CIBR) catching SMH by half of that gap without SMH breaking its own absolute trend — a confirmed handoff would retire the single-leader read, while SMH holding above SPY and the gap staying wide would keep Memory/HBM dominant.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The only theme that is simultaneously #1 ranked, eligible, trend-tagged, and NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.94, crowded=false). The trend gate is the validated leg (absolute-trend gate helps drawdown control here). Durability_bar 0.49 is middling and breadth is 0.0, so this is a single-leader trend continuation lean rather than a broad thesis. Low conviction because dir_accuracy (0.444) is below coin-flip and momentum rank has no alpha.
evidence: rotation leader with margin 1.409 over challenger
theses.dissent: Zero breadth (0.0) and a wide score gap mean the theme is driven by a handful of names; if the HBM trade unwinds on a single earnings print or inventory read, the leader can give back its entire premium with no internal support. The detector explicitly warns against reading rank as a return forecast.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% on a total-return basis over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Rank #2 with modest breadth (0.286) and trend tag, but crowded (crowding_z 1.36, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade. An avoid lean expresses 'no new capital here without a confirmed handoff' rather than a bearish view. Low conviction: the spread to the leader is wide and the AI-software/legacy-software boundary is messy.
theses.dissent: Non-AI Software is the only top-three theme with meaningful breadth (0.286), which historically correlates with more durable leadership than a 0.0-breadth single leader. If a handoff from memory does occur, this would be the natural landing spot, and an avoid lean would miss it.

falsifier.text: IGV total return exceeds SMH total return by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank #3, trend-tagged, with breadth 0.3, but the highest crowding of the top themes (crowding_z 1.67, crowded=true). Crowding is a down-size caution only; avoid expresses reluctance to add capital at the top of an attention spike, not a short or fade.
theses.dissent: Leadership in defensive software can persist through tech rotations, and CIBR's breadth of 0.3 is equal to the highest in the top ranks; crowding is coincident, and the guardrails forbid reading it as a bearish timer.

falsifier.text: CIBR total return exceeds IGV total return by 2% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date
